headline: Binance to Resume Withdrawals After Recovering Most of Stolen Funds
summary: Binance announced it will resume withdrawals after recovering approximately 90% of the funds lost in a recent security hack.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and security breaches and halted withdrawals can trigger broader market uncertainty and regulatory scrutiny across the digital asset sector.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Recovery of stolen funds and resumption of withdrawals directly benefits the platform and its users.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The recovery of 90% of stolen funds and the imminent resumption of withdrawals alleviate immediate solvency and liquidity fears for the crypto exchange.
